findings.title: Reject non-string enum values before equality dispatch
findings.impact: The authority carrier and request-error context retain a non-string object; other constructors execute its equality before later rejection. These are constructor consistency and callback-ordering defects. No actual authentication, execution, grant, or publication bypass was demonstrated.
findings.repair: Require exact str before all enum membership checks. Preserve permitted None in result context; redact malformed request-error context to None. Reject invalid runtime-error/authority/result values with fixed errors before custom equality. Preserve signatures and recognized values.
findings.regressions: Use local counted equality objects and str subclasses at these exact fields. Require zero callbacks and correct rejection/redaction; retain valid enums and nullable result context.

findings.title: Reserve aggregate manifest/result work before variable text scans and projection
findings.impact: The retained valid 4,096-character path is scanned with only 1,982 work units remaining, then to_dict and manifest digest serialization execute. The later wire_object raises ReportLimitError and returns no partial output, but that later rejection does not make the prior work prospective.
findings.repair: Before measuring/copying/hashing the result, reserve its actual aggregate text, structural, sorting and fixed serialization/hash traversal work, including file paths/categories, missing paths, both role-pin sets, summary/finding/artifact values and captured-content hashing. Carry one cumulative reservation through the preflight/projection, or explicitly reserve each subsequent bounded pass before it occurs. Retain accepted manifest bytes/digest semantics and no predecessor edits.
findings.regressions: Add a valid small-manifest positive control and a tight-work long-path rejection that observes zero projection/hash/encoding calls. Cover missing paths, both role pins, aggregate capacity, exact byte/structural limits, and content hashing without timing assertions.
findings.qualification: The 20-character observation also rejects under the deliberately tiny overall work limit; it is not a passing positive control. The 4,096-character observation alone proves text work beyond the entire 2,048-unit budget before projection.
